title: Special Potions
description: Adds new powerful potions with unique abilities like Fire, Ocean, Wind, Warden, Ender, Speed, and Strength effects for survival and PvP gameplay.
body:
Enhance your Minecraft adventure with a brand-new collection of magical potions!

Special Potions introduces unique custom potions that grant players powerful abilities beyond normal Minecraft effects. Whether you want to control the ocean, move with incredible speed, unleash fiery powers, or harness the strength of the Warden — this mod gives you new ways to play.

Features
Custom Potions

🔥 Fire Potion
Gain permanent Fire Resistance and automatically apply the Flame enchantment to every weapon you use. Your attacks will burn enemies without needing enchanted gear.

🌊 Ocean Potion
Receive permanent Water Breathing and use the P key to give nearby enemies Slowness II, making them easier to catch underwater or during combat.

💨 Wind Potion
Use the power of the wind to perform special mobility attacks:

Press N while falling to perform a powerful Mace-style smash attack
Use the custom keybind to spawn and launch a Wind Charge in the direction you are looking

👁 Warden Potion
Harness the power of the Deep Dark:

Fire a devastating Sonic Boom in the direction you are looking
Give other players or mobs Blindness for 1 minute

🌌 Ender Potion
Gain 5 extra hearts after drinking the potion and unlock powerful End-inspired abilities:

Use a special ability with a 5 second cooldown to instantly heal yourself back to 10 hearts

⚡ Speed Potion
Gain permanent Speed II and increased attack speed, allowing for much faster combat and movement.

💪 Strength Potion
Receive permanent Strength II and gain +1 Sharpness on your weapons for extra melee damage.

Extra Features
Custom HUD support
Special ability system
Config support
Simple and lightweight
Why install this mod?

Special Potions makes Minecraft combat and exploration more dynamic by adding exciting abilities and new strategies for survival, PvP, and multiplayer gameplay
